description: A $3.5M ARR new data center deployment stalls at 40% completion, burning $145K/month in idle hardware capacity costs. The platform detects deployment velocity collapse, triggers executive escalation, and CSM deploys an acceleration playbook that completes deployment 12 weeks early -- saving $870K in wasted capacity and eliminating $3.5M churn risk.

phases.name: Deployment Kickoff
phases.description: New $3.5M ARR deployment begins with initial hardware delivery and rack installation. Health starts at 55 (expected for a new, partially-deployed account). First 40% of racks installed on schedule. Project Manager is engaged but stretched thin across multiple initiatives. Early signs of resource constraints appear as customer's internal team is understaffed for the deployment scale.

plot_points.description: Hardware delivery received: 120 GPU servers across 10 racks. Project kickoff call with Infrastructure Director confirms 12-week deployment target. Deployment Cycle Time baseline set at 30 days.

First 4 racks installed and commissioned in 5 days. Installation Completion Rate at 100% for initial batch. Hardware Commissioning Time within target at 5 days. Deployment Team Velocity at 6 servers/day.

Customer Project Manager mentions in weekly sync that two of three assigned deployment engineers have been pulled to another project. Remaining team is single-threaded. CSM notes resource risk in call summary.

csm_action.description: CSM flags resource constraint in weekly report, recommends follow-up with Infrastructure Director on staffing

phases.name: Stall & Drift
phases.description: Deployment velocity collapses. Customer's engineering team fully diverted to a production incident on their existing infrastructure. Remaining racks sit uninstalled in the loading dock. Installation Completion Rate plateaus at 40%. Time-to-First-Workload stuck at 35+ days with no workloads running. Hardware Commissioning Time balloons. $145K/month in idle hardware capacity costs begins accumulating. Configuration errors from rushed partial work cause rework. Health drops from 52 to 38 as deployment KPIs crater.

plot_points.description: Deployment Team Velocity drops from 6 servers/day to 1.5 as customer reassigns engineers. Only 2 additional servers installed this week vs. 12 planned. Project Manager stops attending daily standups.

Installation Completion Rate officially stalls at 40%. No new racks installed in 2 weeks. 6 racks of GPU hardware sitting idle on loading dock. Estimated idle capacity cost: $145K/month. Infrastructure Director unreachable -- consumed by production crisis.

Time-to-First-Workload now at 35 days and counting with zero workloads running. Deployment Cycle Time has exceeded 45 days. GPU Utilization at near-zero -- only test traffic on the 4 installed racks. Configuration errors discovered on 3 of the 4 deployed racks from rushed initial installation.

3 months of $145K/month idle costs now accumulated ($435K). System Uptime on installed racks is nominal but meaningless -- no production workloads running. Documentation Completeness stalled at 35%. Project Manager sends email: 'team is underwater, deployment timeline needs to be reassessed.'

phases.name: Detection & Escalation
phases.description: Platform's deployment velocity monitoring detects the stall pattern: Installation Completion Rate flat at 40% for 4+ weeks, Time-to-First-Workload exceeding 35 days, Deployment Team Velocity in critical zone. System fires 'Deployment Stall' alert correlating resource constraints with idle hardware costs. CSM escalates to VP Engineering with full cost-of-delay analysis. VP Engineering authorizes escalation path.

plot_points.description: Platform fires 'Deployment Velocity Collapse' alert: P1 pillar health at 32, Installation Completion Rate stalled 4+ weeks, projected idle cost burn rate $145K/month. Alert includes cost-of-delay projection: $870K if 6-month delay.

CSM escalates to VP Engineering with deployment stall analysis: $580K in idle costs already accumulated, $145K/month burn rate continuing, 60% of hardware uninstalled, zero production workloads. Recommends executive intervention to unblock customer resource constraints.

csm_action.description: Prepare executive briefing with deployment stall cost analysis, idle hardware ROI impact, and proposed acceleration plan

plot_points.description: VP Engineering calls Infrastructure Director directly. Frames deployment stall as CFO-level issue: $145K/month burn rate on idle hardware, $3.5M ARR at risk if deployment fails. Infrastructure Director acknowledges resource gap but cites competing priorities.

phases.name: Acceleration Sprint
phases.description: On-site acceleration team deployed. Field Engineering Lead brings 4-person crew for parallel deployment. Modified deployment schedule approved: parallel rack installation replacing sequential approach. Configuration errors fixed with automated validation scripts. Deployment velocity recovers to 8+ servers/day. Installation Completion Rate climbs from 40% through 70%, 90%, to 100%. First production workloads go live. Time-to-value reduced by 12 weeks vs. inaction scenario. Health score climbs from 40 to 72 as P1 KPIs recover.

plot_points.description: On-site acceleration team deployed: Field Engineering Lead plus 3 deployment engineers arrive at customer site. Parallel deployment strategy initiated -- 3 racks simultaneously instead of sequential. Infrastructure Director assigns 2 customer engineers back to the project.

csm_action.description: Deploy 4-person field engineering team on-site for 6 weeks; establish parallel deployment methodology; provide automated config validation tools

plot_points.description: Installation Completion Rate crosses 60%. 3 additional racks installed and commissioned. Deployment Team Velocity at 8 servers/day with parallel crews. Configuration Accuracy at 97% using automated validation scripts. Hardware Commissioning Time reduced to 4 days per rack.

Modified deployment schedule formally approved by Infrastructure Director. Remaining 4 racks to be installed in parallel pairs over next 4 weeks. Customer commits 2 dedicated engineers for remainder of deployment. Deployment docs being updated in real-time.

csm_action.description: Co-develop modified parallel deployment schedule with customer PM; establish daily deployment tracker with automated progress reporting

plot_points.description: Installation Completion Rate reaches 90%. 9 of 10 racks operational. First production AI workload goes live on initial 4 racks. GPU Utilization jumps from near-zero to 35% as inference pipeline is deployed. Time-to-First-Workload achieved. Configuration Accuracy at 98%.

All 10 racks installed and commissioned. Installation Completion Rate at 100%. Final rack commissioned in 3 days (best time). Network Readiness Score at 96%. Full hardware fleet operational. Deployment Cycle Time finalized: completed in 22 weeks total vs. projected 34 weeks without intervention.

phases.name: Full Operations
phases.description: All hardware deployed and running production workloads. GPU Utilization climbs to 62% as training and inference pipelines ramp. System Uptime stable at 99.6%. Deployment documentation completed and validated. Time-to-value reduced by 12 weeks vs. inaction scenario, saving $870K in idle capacity costs (12 weeks x $145K/month x 12/4). Retention risk fully eliminated. Infrastructure Director begins discussing Phase 2 expansion. Health stabilizes at 78.

plot_points.description: GPU Utilization reaches 52% as ML training pipelines go live across all 10 racks. System Uptime at 99.6% for the full fleet. Deployment documentation at 95% complete. Project Manager reinstated to weekly syncs with positive sentiment.

GPU Utilization at 62%. First full training run completes successfully. Configuration Accuracy validated at 99% across all racks. Idle hardware cost burn fully eliminated. Deployment project officially closed with 'successful' status.

Post-deployment QBR with Infrastructure Director. CSM presents ROI analysis: $125K CS investment avoided $870K in idle costs, deployment completed 12 weeks early, time-to-value reduced by 40%. Infrastructure Director opens Phase 2 expansion discussion for 5 additional racks in Q3.

kpi_overrides.note: Time-to-First-Workload stuck at 35+ days through stall period, finally achieved at week 21 when first production workload goes live on initial racks
Installation Completion Rate plateaus at 40% from week 7 through week 14, then climbs steadily: 60% (w17), 90% (w21), 100% (w23)
Configuration Accuracy drops to 75% during stall as rushed work causes errors, recovers to 97% with automated validation at week 15, reaches 99% by week 29
Deployment Cycle Time exceeds 45 days during stall (critical zone), improves after acceleration team arrives, finalized at 22 weeks total
Hardware Commissioning Time balloons to 18+ days during stall, drops to 4 days per rack once acceleration team is on-site
Deployment Team Velocity crashes from 6 to 1.5 servers/day during stall, recovers to 8+ with parallel deployment methodology
Documentation Completeness stalls at 35% during stall period, recovers to 95% during Full Operations phase
System Uptime remains stable on deployed hardware throughout -- uptime is not the problem, utilization is. Idle hardware has high uptime but generates no value.
GPU Utilization near-zero through entire stall (weeks 5-14) as no production workloads are running. Jumps to 35% at week 21 when first workload goes live, climbs to 52% (w28) and 62% (w31)
QBR engagement drops during stall as customer leadership is distracted, recovers strongly in post-deployment QBR at week 33
Expansion Probability drops to near-zero during stall (why expand when initial deployment is failing?), recovers to 48% after successful completion and QBR
Budget signals frozen during stall period, thaw after deployment success as Infrastructure Director opens Phase 2 discussion
Capacity Utilization extremely low during stall (40% of hardware not even installed), climbs steadily as deployment completes and workloads ramp

outcomes.title: Idle Hardware Capacity Costs Avoided
outcomes.evidence: Deployment completed 12 weeks ahead of inaction scenario. At $145K/month idle cost burn rate, 12 weeks saved = $870K in avoided waste (12 weeks x $145K/month x 12/4 weeks-to-months). CFO-relevant metric: hardware ROI accelerated by 40%.

outcomes.title: Full Deployment Completed
outcomes.evidence: All 10 racks (120 GPU servers) installed, configured, and running production workloads. Installation Completion Rate at 100%. Configuration Accuracy at 99%. $3.5M ARR secured through successful deployment.

outcomes.title: Time-to-Value Reduced by 40%

outcomes.title: Retention Risk Eliminated
outcomes.evidence: Full $3.5M ARR was at risk if deployment failed. Stalled deployments have 68% probability of customer abandonment within 6 months. Successful completion eliminated churn risk and Infrastructure Director opened Phase 2 expansion discussion.

outcomes.title: Net ROI of CS Intervention
outcomes.evidence: $870K in idle costs avoided minus $125K intervention cost (on-site team $85K + schedule optimization $8K + escalation coordination $5K + CSM time $27K) = $745K net value. 596% ROI on CS investment. CFO story: every $1 spent on acceleration saved $6.96.
